newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction federal investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Sunday it had invited bids up to Monday for the auction of three-year, five-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds.
The result of the auction would be announced on Tuesday with settlement set for Wednesday, the bank said.

In the previous auction on October 29, the bank accepted bids worth 80.3928 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds and 598.55 million rupees at par for the ten-year bonds. No bids were received for the five-year maturity bonds.
